Wheel options:

turns.replyText:
How do I use it properly the very first time?
Absolutely — the first time is all about acclimating your cat slowly, not getting them to run right away.

Best way to use the Cat Exercise Wheel the very first time




Take the wheel off the base at first
For the first few days, lay the wheel on its side on the floor. This makes it feel much less intimidating.


Let your cat explore it at their own pace
Don’t place your cat on it forcefully. Let them sniff it, walk near it, and get comfortable being around it.


Wait until they seem relaxed around it
Keep the wheel on the floor until your cat can approach it confidently without seeming tense or ready to run away. Good signs are if they:


play near it


sit inside it


relax around it without encouragement


Set it back on the base once they’re comfortable
After your cat seems at ease with the wheel on the floor, put it upright on the base.


Start with stepping on, not running
The goal at first is just to help your cat feel confident stepping onto the wheel. Don’t rush them into walking or running.


Hold the wheel steady if needed
If your cat gets startled when the wheel moves, you can hold it still with your hand while they practice stepping on and off. At first, it’s okay if it doesn’t move at all.
